en-US.name: PealSync
en-US.summary: Family tasks, schedule, and grocery cart, hands-free.
en-US.description: PealSync brings your family's tasks, schedule, and grocery cart to your Echo Show. Ask what's on today's schedule, add a task, or check the grocery cart — with a calm, olive-toned visual card on screen.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask PealSync what's on today's schedule
Alexa, tell PealSync to add pack soccer bag to the tasks
